provenance.provenance_evidence: The project-owned projection passage reproduces the retained calendar body hash exactly. Its artifact manifest records the bounded public-domain 1862 Pustet antecedent, the separate 1962 target, and every editorial transformation; neither witness is represented as owning the projected bytes. The 1962 reading was established on that edition's page images rather than its text layer, cross-read against the Benziger conformed printing. Differences from the antecedent: 1862 sets no comma after quaesumus (quaesumus Domine); 1962 sets Excita, quaesumus, Domine,; 1862 closes the petition with a full stop before Qui vivis; 1962 sets a colon (salvari:); 1862 sets 'in unitate Spiritus sancti Deus, per omnia'; 1962 sets 'in unitate Spiritus Sancti, Deus: per omnia' -- lower-case sancti, no comma before Deus, comma instead of colon after it; OCR noise in the 1862 layer, not textual: the ornamental E recognises as 'inXcita' / 'Pj' across 13231-13232, and 'liberante salvari' reads 'liberrinte salvdn'; OCR noise, not textual: the 1862 response sign at line 13240 recognises as 'JL Amen.' for R-with-bar Amen. Corroboration: Venice 1570 (degraded-latin; the edition's own record forbids resting a claim or a negative on a raw search over it, so this is corroboration only and nothing here rests on it) at text-layer lines 5707-5711, which prints 'Excita [quaesumus] domine potentiam tuam, et veni: ut ab imminentibus peccatorum nostrorum periculis te mereamur protegente eripi, te libe[rante]'.

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Excita, quaesumus, Domine, potentiam tuam, et veni: ut ab imminentibus
peccatorum nostrorum periculis, te mereamur protegente eripi, te liberante
salvari: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre in unitate Spiritus Sancti, Deus:
per omnia saecula saeculorum. R. Amen.

propers.name: Secret
propers.text:
Haec sacra nos, Domine, potenti virtute mundatos, ad suum faciant puriores
venire principium. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum, Filium tuum: Qui
tecum vivit et regnat in unitate Spiritus Sancti, Deus: per omnia saecula
saeculorum. R. Amen.
